description: Send one message (up to 900 characters) to the people dm_followup_preview counts as can: those who wrote in the last 24 hours and have had no follow-up since. Pass the count you were shown as confirm_count; if the people reachable changed by more than 10%, nothing is queued and the new count comes back (can). At most one follow-up per person per message of theirs; never outside the 24 hours, never to someone who replied STOP or asked for a person. Messages go through the same hourly cap of 190 as automations, about 60 a minute until it is reached. Logged as a Follow up with its own numbers (dm_automations_list followups).

automation_id.description: Only the people this automation reached; omit for everyone

confirm_count.description: The can count you were shown

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: dm_followup_send
title: Send a follow-up
